enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out clothes. Close closet. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place items in bag. Zip bag.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Check vital signs. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Palpate abdomen. Administer medication. Write prescriptions. Update patient records. Discuss treatment with colleagues. Attend team meeting. Return phone calls. Complete paperwork. Walk to next patient.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter house. Remove shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Lean back. Change channel. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Adjust pillow. Change posture. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and starting a load of laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Turn on shower. Step in. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Place clothes in washer. Add detergent. Press start.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Read screen. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over. Close eyes. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Continue sleeping.
